title: fix: installing an extension enables nothing until an app turns it on
head: 6654948663235a0e6fb2f9a715f9bf91b285ad25
body:
Install enables nothing; each app is switched on explicitly (gap analysis C1).

install_staged no longer inserts the new package into every app's enabled set. On a fresh install the package stays disabled for every app. On an update, apps that had the package enabled keep it for as long as the new version still supports them, and the enablement and theme choice are cleared for apps the new version dropped.

A new test, installing_a_package_leaves_it_disabled_until_an_app_turns_it_on, fails against the old behaviour and passes now. Tests that relied on install enabling the package switch it on explicitly instead, and the non-theme-choice test enables the plug-in first so it still kills the reader mutant that drops the kind check.

Adds the store mutant "install enables every listed app" to docs/mutation_check.py; the harness now catches 35 of 35 store and 27 of 27 core mutants.

Verification: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace (63 + 49 tests), both wasm32 checks, and the mutation harness for core and store.
